description.content: Adds a new customer to the system and returns details of the added customer. If a customer with the specified email already exists, and `OverwriteExisting` is set to `true`, then the existing customer profile information is overwritten and the existing customer data returned. If `OverwriteExisting` is set to `false`, an error response is returned. Note this operation supports [Portfolio Access Tokens](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/concepts/multi-property).
